Vibhu Garg
Ankit Pruthi | hq_location_city = [[Haryana]], [[Gurugram]] | hq_location_country = India | num_locations = | num_locations_year = | area_served = India, [[Middle East]], [[Southeast Asia]] | key_people = Kapil Makhija ([[Chief executive officer|MD & CEO]]) | services = [[Software as a service|SaaS]], [[Warehouse management system|Warehouse management]], [[Logistics]] | owner = | parent = | subsidiaries = | website = {{URL|https://unicommerce.com/}} }} Unicommerce (officially Unicommerce eSolutions Limited) is an Indian technology company that provides an [[e-commerce]] enablement [[Software as a service|SaaS]] platform and is headquartered in Gurugram, India. In [[fiscal year]] 2023, Unicommerce's software platform processed 20% to 25% of all e-commerce [[Drop shipping|dropship]] transaction volumes in India.{{cite web |title=IPO Note - Unicommerce Esolutions Ltd |url=https://idbicapital.com/InstitutionReports/Uploads/Unicommerce%20Solutions_IPO%20Note_06082024.pdf |website=IDBI Capital |publisher=IDBI Capital |access-date=17 May 2026}} The company is listed on [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] in India. == History == Unicommerce was founded in February 2012 by Ankit Pruthi, Karun Singla and Vibhu Garg, who were alumni of [[IIT Delhi]].{{cite news |last1=Mitra |first1=Sudeshna |title=IPO-Bound Unicommerce Strengthens Board With Five Key Appointments |url=https://inc42.com/buzz/ipo-bound-unicommerce-strengthens-board-with-five-key-appointments/ |access-date=17 May 2026 |publisher=Inc42 |date=20 Dec 2023}} Singla was a former employee of ecommerce firm [[Snapdeal]].{{cite news |last1=Bailay |first1=Rasul |last2=Shrivastava |first2=Aditi |title=Snapdeal in talks to acquire online order management platform Unicommerce|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/retail/snapdeal-in-talks-to-acquire-online-order-management-platform-unicommerce/articleshow/45558291.cms |access-date=17 May 2026 |publisher=The Economic Times |date=18 Dec 2014}} Snapdeal was one of the earliest clients of Unicommerce and the company raised [[Seed money|angel funding]] from its co-founders [[Kunal Bahl]] and Rohit Bansal. In 2013, the company received undisclosed [[Venture capital|funding]] from [[Naren Gupta#Nexus Venture Partners|Nexus Venture Partners]]. In 2014, the company raised $10 million from [[Tiger Global Management|Tiger Global]].{{cite news |last1=Shrivastava |first1=Aditi |title=Unicommerce raises $10 million from US-based investment firm Tiger Global |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz/startups/unicommerce-raises-10-million-from-us-based-investment-firm-tiger-global/articleshow/45067325.cms |access-date=17 May 2026 |publisher=The Economic Times |date=7 Nov 2014}} Following an [[Takeover|acquisition bid]] by Snapdeal (later rebranded as AceVector Group), the investment from Tiger Global was settled through a share allotment scheme. Snapdeal bought the company in March 2015 at a valuation of more than $40 million.{{cite news |last1=Dubey |first1=Jyotindra |title=Did Snapdeal Founders Make A Killing In The Unicommerce Deal? |url=https://www.vccircle.com/did-snapdeal-founders-make-a-killing-in-the-unicommerce-deal |access-date=17 May 2026 |publisher=VCCircle |date=5 Jun 2017}} Kapil Makhija was appointed as the CEO following the resignation of the original founders of the company in 2017.{{cite news |last1=Gooptu |first1=Biswarup |title=Founders of Snapdeal-owned Unicommerce eSolutions quit |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz/startups/founders-of-snapdeal-owned-unicommerce-esolutions-quit/articleshow/60177953.cms |access-date=17 May 2026 |publisher=The Economic Times |date=22 Aug 2017}} The company filed for [[Initial public offering|IPO]] in 2024.{{cite news |last1=Ashrafi |first1=Md Salman |title=E-commerce SaaS platform Unicommerce files DRHP with SEBI |url=https://entrackr.com/2024/01/e-commerce-saas-platform-unicommerce-files-drhp-with-sebi/ |access-date=17 May 2026 |publisher=Entrackr |date=6 Jan 2024}} The IPO launched in August of the same year and was oversubscribed 168 times, leading to its official listing.{{cite news |title=Unicommerce eSolutions IPO listing: Shares debut with a solid 117% premium |url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/unicommerce-esolutions-ipo-listing-shares-debut-with-a-solid-117-premium-124081300422_1.html |access-date=17 May 2026 |publisher=Business Standard |date=13 Aug 2024}}{{cite news |last1=Mukherjee |first1=Anubhav |title=Unicommerce IPO receives strong response, subscribed 168.35 times on third bidding day; Issue oversubscribed, check GMP |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/ipo/unicommerce-ipo-receives-strong-response-subscribed-168-35-times-on-third-bidding-day-issue-oversubscribed-check-gmp-11723136574520.html |access-date=17 May 2026 |publisher=Mint by Hindustan Times |date=8 Aug 2024}} == Business == Unicommerce provides SaaS based [[Order fulfillment|order management and fulfilment platform]] to ecommerce and retail businesses.{{cite news |last1=Mitra |first1=Sudeshna |title=IPO-Bound Unicommerce Strengthens Board With Five Key Appointments |url=https://inc42.com/buzz/ipo-bound-unicommerce-strengthens-board-with-five-key-appointments/ |access-date=17 May 2026 |publisher=Inc42 |date=20 Dec 2023}} In 2024, the company acquired Shipway to expand its logistics tracking and post-purchase automation capabilities.{{cite news |last1=Abrar |first1=Peerzada |title=Unicommerce announces acquiring e-commerce technology platform Shipway |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/unicommerce-to-acquire-e-commerce-technology-platform-shipway-124111200953_1.html |access-date=17 May 2026 |publisher=Business Standard |date=12 Nov 2024}} Unicommerce achieved profitability in fiscal year 2021, driven by increased e-commerce transaction volumes in India. The company has remained continuously profitable since.{{cite web |title=Unicommerce eSolutions |url=https://dhan.co/stocks/unicommerce-esolutions-ltd-financial-results/ |website=Dhan |publisher=Raise Securities Private Limited |access-date=17 May 2026}} == See also == * [[E-commerce in India]] * [[Software as a Service]] == References == {{reflist}} {{Portal bar|Technology}} [[Category:Companies based in Gurgaon]] [[Category:Companies based in Haryana]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Software companies of India]] [[Category:E-commerce in India]] [[Category:E-commerce software]] {{India-company-stub}}
